$why: The ORACLE HEADINGS: each prepends a block of precomputed evidence to a gate prompt and tells
the gate how to treat it — "hard evidence, treat as ground truth". That framing is the whole
point of precomputing it. Without it a gate re-derives what it was already given, which is the
max-iteration exhaustion these oracles exist to prevent.
One body per oracle, because each names its own source and a gate is handed only its own.
description: Prepends precomputed oracle evidence to a QA gate prompt and frames it as ground truth.
